content: Customer Vedant Thakur contacted agent Neha Kapoor expressing frustration that his auto policy (Policy #AV-45231) expired early on September 15, 2026, due to lack of automatic renewal. He requested options for reinstatement for an upcoming trip. The agent explained the cause of expiration and provided a renewal quote outlining two options: retroactive reinstatement for up to 30 days subject to underwriting approval, or a new policy effective immediately with a loyalty discount.

action_items: Customer to review the attached renewal quote and choose between retroactive reinstatement or issuing a new policy.
